title: Procuration
summary: PRO'CURA'TION, noun [Latin procuratio. See Procure.] 1. The act of procuring. [Procurement is generally used.] 2. The management of another's affairs. 3. The instrument by which a person is empowered

inlines.v: PRO'CURA'TION, noun [Latin procuratio. See Procure.] 1. The act of procuring. [Procurement is generally used.] 2. The management of another's affairs. 3. The instrument by which a person is empowered to transact the affairs of another. 4. A sum of money paid to the bishop or archdeacon by incumbents, on account of visitations; called also proxy.
